description.content:
This endpoint allows a variety of actions to be taken on a <<glossary:loan officer>>.

> 📌 Available actions
  **PROMOTE** - Promote loan officer to organization admin
  **DEMOTE** - Demote loan officer from organization admin
  **ENABLE** - Activate loan officer
  **DISABLE** - Deactivate loan officer
  **SEND_WELCOME_EMAIL** - Send a welcome email to loan officer
  **CHANGE_ORG** - Move loan officer to a different organization
